purpose: Teach: 谷口/柳沢/奥田/新井/荒木/浅野/村山/大田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、谷口氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Dad, when you were young, you started that joint venture with Taniguchi, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle, measured. Light curiosity opening the question—not probing, but inviting him to remember. Warm respect in the voice. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは柳沢先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. My father learned so much from working under Yanagisawa.
lines.style: Calm, honoring the past. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. Speaking as if both the memory and the gratitude are present tense. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、奥田氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: Dad, when you were young, you planned that overseas expansion with Okuda, didn't you?
lines.style: Same gentle curiosity as before, but softer—almost wistful himself now. Opening the door to something he knows mattered. Slightly longer pause before the question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新井氏を社員初期メンバーとして採用された
lines.en: Yes. My father brought Arai on as one of the first team members.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective. Speaking about a choice that had consequences. Not proud, but honest about its importance. A small breath before the name, like he's picturing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、荒木氏とは同窓の付き合いだった
lines.en: Dad, when you were young, Araki was a classmate you stayed close with, wasn't he?
lines.style: Softer still, almost tender. The wistfulness deepening—he's drawn into his father's world. A slight lift at the end, genuinely wanting confirmation of something he senses mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは浅野氏を経理の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. My father made Asano the cornerstone of our accounting department.
lines.style: Steady, grounded. Speaking of trust and structure. The weight of a good decision made years ago, still holding. Quiet certainty—no doubt in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、村山氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Dad, when you were young, you founded that overseas company with Murayama, didn't you?
lines.style: The wistfulness peaks here—almost yearning. Like he's walking through the hallway of his father's younger self. Slower pace. The question becomes almost an offering, not an interrogation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは大田氏に法務全般を任された
lines.en: Yes. My father entrusted all legal matters to Ota.
lines.style: A gentle closing. Wise, complete. The voice settles, as if this is the last stone placed in the foundation. Warmth beneath the composure. A breath of finality without abruptness.
